scope_notes: Original comparison includes exactly the three baseline repeats per point; qualification runs are excluded by role, and the declared P2 c8 third resumed repeat is included.
All current performance points use the same three executable fingerprints.
P1/P2 medians are medians of three throughput measurements, not pooled request latency.
Original backend and compiler differ from the current direct-object backend and GCC16; this is a historical system comparison, not a single-change experiment.
Slow-read duration shares concern only requests above the 100ms logging threshold, matched to measurement windows; they are not CPU shares.
P3 has failed final reconciliation and forced shutdown; partial operation counts do not establish a successful turnover result.
